source_inspection: Shared evidence dialog: archived original/English passages, page locators, typed details, field support, definitions and missing reasons; PDF access remains disconnected.

publication_copy.automatic: New successful country reports become visible automatically.
publication_copy.pinned: This version stays displayed until you choose another or unpin.
publication_copy.ad_hoc: This report stays separate from shared country reports.

empty_state_rule: explain the specific cause and one useful next action; never substitute a fabricated summary
accessibility_target: WCAG 2.2 AA; verification required before claiming conformance
state_model: Browser-local named/current view preferences per profile version; session navigation position; same-target predicates; exact archived codebook. Optional request setup remains in memory.
share_rule: a saved link preserves snapshot/filter state but never grants document access
density: summary first; advanced filters and provenance on demand
customization_rule: Every control changes scope, an analysis rule, output fields/sections or execution behavior; no generic audience/length fields
regional_status_basis: Actual supplied inventory; no production country releases yet
mvp: One published Country Profile per country from curated NDC/NAP evidence
primary_action: Read an existing profile; Generate profile explicitly invokes the existing one-country worker.
prompt_inspection: Current exact Markdown contents and file hashes, mapped to views and pipeline stages. Historical runs must display archived components, not this mutable catalog.
optional_results: Clearly labeled synthetic interface fixtures; no executed optional reports.
